SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro.en: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!
SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro.fr: Allez, viens !\nL'honneur de mon marin est en jeu !

SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle.en: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nAPATIA?
SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle.fr: As-tu vu le GOUROU DE LA PÊCHE à\nAPATIA ?

SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro.en: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!
SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro.fr: Tu sais ce qu'on dit des marins et\ndes combats !

SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle.en: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?
